content:
We are still fixing some issues with replay update! But we’ve added an option that many players has requested!
Checkout the entire Replay v3.0 update changelog in This Post!
And still, we are getting feedback/suggestions with the new replay update! Please don’t forget to join our Discord Server!
Changes Added Auto open containers option in replay. It does open/close the containers(e.g. inventory, crafting table and chests) in player cam mode. It is disabled by default, you can enable it on replay settings. Fixed issues with pearl hangs, and added a marker in replays. Fixed an issue with dragon death sound. You can rebind with mouse buttons for replay/ranked controls binding. Fixed an issue where dragon fly away height was incorrect. Also changed the rendering of dragon target distance. Some bug fixes in replay. Bug Reports Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
title: Mod Update - v6.0.4 Changelog

content:
We are fixing some issues, and there’s noticeable change with the blind portal behavior.
Checkout the entire Replay v3.0 update changelog in This Post!
And also, we are getting feedback/suggestions with the new replay update! Please don’t forget to join our Discord Server!
Changes Blind portals generated in ocean biomes will no longer be fixed at Y-70. We already had logic to generate blind portals on the surface. However, a side effect of this logic was that blind portals generated in ocean biomes would always spawn at Y-70. After reviewing the code, we realized that this is different from vanilla behavior, so we fixed it. Blind portals can now generate at much higher(like as vanilla). As a result, it will be difficult to reach without throwing ender pearls or placing blocks to climb up. Fixed some replay bugs. Bug Reports Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
title: Mod Update - v6.0.3 Changelog

content:
This update focuses on the new replay system, along with some smaller changes.
We’re also collecting feedback and suggestions! Join our Discord Server!
Changes Replay v3.0 Update This update brings a complete overhaul to the replay system, with lots of new features, bug fixes, QOL improvements and more. Not to mention a complete tutorial to get you acquainted! Summary of all the replay changes: New replay UI & controls Replay tutorial First-person POV Player health, hunger, breath, inventory & more stats Visualize mob/player pathing Splits viewer, navigation & alignment Piglin trades stat screen X-ray spawners/chests/gold blocks Pie chart recording Player UI interaction recording Looted/unlooted toggle for chests New timeline icons (by ollie) And more! Fixed an issue where ocean seed types would sometimes have both a shipwreck and buried treasure at spawn. All strongholds now generate with the same rooms and layout, and still have the same number of eyes. However, they can still be affected by other generated structures, such as caves, dungeons and mineshafts. We are looking into a way to fix this in the future. Added more splash texts. Bug Reports Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
title: Mod Update - v6.0.0 Changelogs

content:
This is the first public changelogs in this blog! We are so glad with it 😊
Anyways, this update isn’t big update. but also, this is preparation for the Replay v3.0 Update. Focused on server storage for replays especially.
Changes Replay storage update As we’ve mentioned in the last maintenance announcement, We’ve changed a lot of backend stuffs for the replay storage, Due to this change, every past match replays are deleted from the server. However, you can still access on Weekly Race replays. Replay expiration time has been extended from 3 days to 7 days. Ranked mode match replays in the Top 50 record leaderboard of each season will now be stored as no expiration time. You can no longer download or watch more than 5 replays per minute Updated tab selections in ranked settings screen. Added more splash texts. Bug Reports Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
